leak.notes: The Leak Adjustment form can be used to see if your water account qualifies for an adjustment, and then submit the application to the Water Utilities department for completion. To be eligible for a leak adjustment, your water account must meet the following criteria:- Your account must be a Residential account.- The water usage for the requested time period must be at least twice the average usage of the same time periods over the past three years. templates.body:
When Residents Have Not Transferred Accounts

Residents have ample time to Transfer utilities before/after move in . when you get emails from Conservice advising accts haven't been closed because tenant hasn't started an acct, you certainly can notify the PM so they are aware but your response to Conservice should be proceed with deactivation.
Only time we should have back and forth is when utilities can't be shut off UNTIL a new acct is started.
If you remember that and follow that there will be less back and forth
